verdict.rationale: The README's installation options list 'Winget', a standard package manager, so first-party package-manager installation is indicated. The evidence is only a bare heading, with no commands or detail. Docker, pre-built release binaries, llama.app and building from source are alternative install paths, not package-manager installs, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented Winget install commands, evidence of other common package managers (e.g. Homebrew, apt, Nix), and hands-on corroboration that package-manager installs are quick and work.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the runtime quickly using a standard package manager
